risks.note: The business is exposed to distributing expired, defective or counterfeit products, transportation damage and customer returns, which could cause financial losses, reputational damage and product liability claims - and any claim, regardless of validity, can erode customer trust. Mitigation is buying directly from manufacturers meeting agreed quality standards, with defects replaced by the manufacturer.

Any disruption to warehouse operations, or to the development of new warehousing and logistics facilities - including natural disasters or catastrophic events - could materially impact the business. Redundancy across a nationwide network of 100+ distribution warehouses is the stated buffer.
risks.risk: Operational disruption to warehouses and logistics

risks.note: Growth is acquisition-led, so failure to identify, complete and successfully integrate acquisitions, or acquisitions failing to deliver internal results, would directly hit financial performance. Mitigated by a dedicated M&A team targeting territorial expansion/dominance or unique product mix, plus business-team-led integration support to newly acquired entities.

Lack of available liquid financial assets such as cash may cause difficulties in achieving projected growth because the business is working capital intensive. IPO proceeds provided liquidity for growth plans, alongside measures to drive revenue growth and optimise costs to improve cash flows.
risks.risk: Liquidity risk in a working-capital-intensive model

risks.note: The Company has no control over the supply of products from suppliers, which could be impacted by a number of factors; contingency plans allow transfer of goods from alternate locations within the group.
risks.risk: Supply chain disruption / dependence on suppliers

risks.note: Loss of data and unauthorised access to IT systems from a security breach could adversely impact operations - material given the platform runs on a proprietary ERP and digital ordering stack. Mitigated through antivirus, firewalls, remote data backups and the latest software versions.

Human capital is a key pillar and high attrition rates could impair performance; retention is managed through learning and skill-development workshops, engagement initiatives, the Entero Cares programme, rewards/recognition and cross-functional mobility for high performers.
